blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision language models (VLMs) are used in creative tasks such as visual storytelling, design ideation, art interpretation, and advertising. Yet we lack principled ways to measure the lateral reasoning of these models compared to human potential. We introduce CREATE, a semi-automatically constructed benchmark containing 155 visual Remote Associates Test problems. These problems require a solver to find an underlying connection among three seemingly dissimilar images. We conduct a human study (N=25) to validate and ground the quality of our benchmark, and evaluate 11 VLMs. Our findings show that most VLMs underperform humans on this task. Our experiments indicate that the associative ability of VLMs depends on the cue concepts provided in the text and does not universally extend to visual puzzles.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)被用在视觉故事讲述,设计创意,艺术诠释,广告等创造性任务上. 然而,我们缺乏衡量这些模式相对于人类潜力的横向推理的原则性方法。 我们引入了CREATE,一个半自动构建的基准,包含155个视觉远程关联测试问题. 这些问题需要一个解决者在三种看似相异的图像中找到一个根本的联系. 我们进行一项人类研究(N=25),以验证和确定我们的基准质量,并评估11个自愿最低水平。 我们的研究结果表明,大多数VLM在这项任务中表现不佳。 我们的实验表明,VLMs的关联能力取决于文本中提供的提示概念,并不普遍延伸到视觉谜题.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Puzzles have served as instruments for measuring human creativity, requiring solvers to make connections that are not obviously related ( Guilford, 1950 ; Maier, 1931 ) . A key aspect of this creative puzzle solving is ‘insight’, the sudden restructuring of a problem that brings a previously hidden solution into view, which often tends to arrive abruptly in short puzzles Kounios and Beeman (2014) ; Metcalfe and Wiebe (1987) . The Remote Associates Test (RAT) is a widely used framework for studying insight and human creativity ( Mednick, 1962 ) , where a solver is given three cue words ( e.g., sandwich , golf , and house ) and must find a fourth word that links them all ( e.g., ( club )). Olteţeanu and Zunjani (2020) has extended these problems into the visual domain by replacing the cue words with cue images. While these visual RATs are an attractive candidate for evaluating creativity VLMs, existing RAT problems consist of fixed, manually curated sets reused for over 5 decades.
blocks.zh: 谜题作为衡量人类创造力的工具,要求解题者建立明显不相干的联系(Guilford,1950;Maier,1931. 这种创造性的解谜方案的一个关键方面是“洞察力 ” ( Insight), 即突然重组一个将先前隐藏的解决方案引出视线的问题, 远程联想测试(RAT)是一个被广泛使用的学习洞察力和人类创造力的框架(Mednick,1962年),其中一个解答者被赋予了三个提示词(如三明治,高尔夫球和房子等),必须找到第四个将它们全部联系起来的词(如(俱乐部)). Oltieanu和Zunjani(2020年)将这些问题扩展至视觉领域, 虽然这些可视的RAT是评价创造力的VLM的有吸引力的候选,但现有的RAT问题包括了50多年来被再利用的固定的,手工处理的相机.

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, we propose a human-AI collaboration framework to construct the CREATE benchmark (piCture REmote Associates TEst) comprising of 155 puzzles (see Figure 1 for an example), and position visual RAT problems as an evaluation framework for creativity in VLMs. We ask two research questions, RQ1 : How do humans and VLMs differ in solving visual RAT problems? RQ2 : Do VLMs rely on language as an intermediate step when solving visual RAT problems? For a subset of 80 problems, we conduct a human study with 25 participants, each of whom attempted 16 problems. Complementing this, we evaluat seven open-weight and four proprietary VLMs.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们建议建立一个人与AI合作框架,以构建包含155个谜题(例如见图1)的CREATE基准(piCture Remote Associates TEst),并将视觉RAT问题定位为VLM的创造性评价框架. 我们提出了两个研究问题,RQ1:在解决视觉RAT问题时,人类和VLM有什么不同? RQ2 : (英语). VLMs在解决视觉RAT问题时,是否依赖语言作为中间步骤? 对于80个问题的子集,我们进行了一项人类研究,有25名参与者,每个参与者都尝试了16个问题. 作为补充,我们评估了7个开放重量和4个专有VLM。

blocks.en:
Our human study shows that, on average, humans solve 22.8% of problems, with 70% of the problems solved by at least one of the five participants. Only one VLM outperforms humans on this task, namely, Claude-Opus-5.5 , which solves 32.5% of the puzzles in a zero-shot setting. It solves 4 puzzles that no human participant solves, but fails on 34 puzzles that at least one human participant solves. When VLMs answer incorrectly, they are more than twice as likely as humans to describe what the images literally depict. Presenting the same puzzles as text-only RAT problems raised every model’s accuracy by at least 30 points, with the best model reaching 90%. The models could therefore find the association once the cue words were given, but could not reliably recover those words from the images, which points to visual abstraction as their principal limitation.
This work makes three key contributions. First , we provide the CREATE benchmark, comprising 155 visual RAT problems. Second , we conduct a human study to validate and ground each instance in human responses. Third , we evaluate 11 VLMs and show they underperform compared to human performance. Our analysis reveals that their errors are likely due to failed visual abstraction rather than from the association reasoning itself.
blocks.zh:
我们的人类研究表明,人类平均能解决22.8%的问题,其中70%的问题至少由五个参与者中的一个解决. 只有一款VLM在这项任务上超越了人类,即克洛德-奥普斯-5.5,在零镜头设定中解了32.5%的谜题. 它解决了没有人类参与者解决的4个谜题,但在至少一个人类参与者解决的34个谜题上失败了. 当VLMs错误地回答时,他们比人类更可能描述图像的字面描述. 将相同的谜题与文本唯一的RAT问题一样,使每个模型的准确性至少提高了30分,最佳模型达到了90%. 因此,模型一旦给出了提示词就可以找到关联,但无法可靠地从图像中恢复这些词语,这说明视觉抽象是其主要限制.
这项工作作出了三大贡献。 首先,我们提供CREATE基准,包括155个视觉RAT问题。 第二,我们进行一项人类研究,以验证和论证人类反应中的每个实例。 第三,我们评价了11个甚高频,显示它们与人类性能相比表现不佳。 我们的分析显示,他们的错误可能是由于视觉抽象失败,而不是由于协会推理本身。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior work has developed textual and visual puzzle benchmarks to test different reasoning capabilities of LLMs and VLMs. Wordplay-style text puzzles include the work by Samdarshi et al. (2024) , who built a puzzle benchmark inspired by The New York Times’ Connection 2 2 2 https://www.nytimes.com/games/connections to evaluate models on the task of organizing 16 words into four groups of four words with shared associations within each group. Jiang et al. (2023) developed BRAINTEASER , a multiple choice question answering dataset designed to test models’ ability to exhibit lateral thinking defying commonsense reasoning. Chia et al. (2024) developed PuzzleVQA to assess the model’s visual perception and pattern completion, asking the model to complete missing patterns in colors, numbers, sizes, or shapes. Ghosal et al. (2024) presented AlgoPuzzleVQA , evaluating VLMs on algorithmic puzzles requiring visual, language, and algorithmic reasoning capabilities. Xu et al. (2026) developed MultiPun , a benchmark comprising multi-modal puns, and found that VLMs struggle to distinguish genuine puns from distractors. Lee et al. (2025) and Kraaijveld et al. (2025) similarly evaluated models on rebus puzzles that require recovering words or phrases from pictures, symbols, and spatial arrangements.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作已经制定了文字和视觉拼图基准,以测试LLM和VLM的不同推理能力. Wordplay风格的文字谜题包括Samdarshi等人(2024年)的作品,他们根据"纽约时报"的Connection 2 2 2 2 https://www.nytimes.com/games/connections的启发,构建了谜题基准,评价16个单词组成四组四个单词的任务模式,每个组内部有共同的协会. Jiang等人(2023年)开发了BRAINTEASER, 一个多重选择问题回答数据集, 旨在测试模型展示反常推理的横向思维的能力。 Chia等 (2024)开发出PizzleVQA来评估模型的视觉感知和图案完成,要求模型在颜色,数字,大小或形状上完成缺失的图案. Ghosal等人(2024年)介绍了AlgoPizzleVQA,评价需要视觉、语言和算法推理能力的算法谜题的VLM。 徐等 (2026年)开发了由多模式活塞活塞构成的基准"多平台"(MultiPun ),并发现VLM为区分真活塞活塞活塞和分心活塞而挣扎. 李等 (2025)和克赖伊维尔德等. (2025)在需要从图片,符号和空间安排中取出词或短语的重载谜题上同样评价模型.

blocks.en: Wu et al. (2025) released Bongard-OpenWorld , extending classical Bongard Problems ( Bongard, 1970 ) to open-world images, where the task requires a solver to segregate 12 images into two sets of six based on a concept that sets them apart. Similarly, Raganato et al. (2023) presented the visual word sense disambiguation task, where the goal was to identify an image that corresponds to the intended meaning of a given ambiguous word out of ten candidate images. Aditya et al. (2018) ’s work remains closest to ours, with their proposed image-riddles dataset comprising three images and the task of finding the common connection among them. However, we found that a significant portion of the riddles in the benchmark did not require cross-image associations. We found that captioning a single image with Qwen3.5-4B produced the exact answer for 42.9% of riddles, and for 63.0% once synonyms are accepted.
blocks.zh: 吴等. (2025年)发布了"邦加德-OpenWorld"(Bongard-OpenWorld .),将古典"邦加德问题"(Bongard,1970年)扩展为"开放世界"(Open-world)图像,其中任务要求解析器将12个图像分解为两组六组,基于一个将它们分解的概念. 同样地,Raganato等人(2023年)提出了视觉词"感知分化"的任务,目标是从十个候选图像中识别出一个符合给定的"模棱两可"词的意向. Aditya等人(2018年)的工作仍然与我们的工作最相近,他们提出的图像-中间数据组包括三个图像,并负责寻找它们之间的共同联系。 然而,我们发现,基准中的很大一部分谜语并不需要跨图像联系。 我们发现,用Qwen3.5-4B来描述一个单一的图像,为42.9%的谜题提供了准确的答案,在同义词被接受后为63.0%。

blocks.en: 3 CREATE -ing the benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 CREATE - 基准

blocks.en: We propose a human-AI collaboration framework to build our benchmark. First, we used Gemini-3.8-Flash to construct text-only RAT puzzles (i.e., 3 cue words and an answer word that connects them). Specifically, we start with 532 seed domains spanning diverse areas such as food, space, and entertainment. For each domain, we prompted the model to propose several connecting answer words and, for each answer word, a cluster of polysemous cue words that all bear the same semantic relation to it ( e.g., is a or part of , symbol of ). Each cue word had to have two distinct word senses: a domain sense that links it to the answer word, and an alternate sense that can be visually depicted as an object or a scene. For example, for the answer word cocktail , the cue words included screwdriver and grasshopper , whose alternate senses are a tool and an insect, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们建议建立一个人类-AI合作框架来建立我们的基准。 首先,我们使用双子座-3.8-Flash来构建只使用文本的RAT谜题(即3个提示词和一个连接它们的答案词). 具体地说,我们从532个种子领域开始,涉及食品、空间和娱乐等不同领域。 对于每个域,我们促使模型提出几个连接的回答单词,对于每个回答单词,一组多相声的提示单词,它们都与之具有相同的语义关系(例如,是.的一个或一部分,符号.). 每个提示词必须有两个截然不同的单词感:一个域名感将它与答案词相链接,另一个可被视觉地描绘为物体或场景的替代感. 例如,对于答题词"鸡尾酒",提示词包括螺丝刀和"草hopper",其交替的感官分别是一个工具和昆虫.

blocks.en: The model generated 3,340 cue-word candidates. In order to ensure that the cue words can be represented as adequate cue images in visual RAT puzzles, we apply a filtering step to account for high word familiarity, high imageability, and high distance between the two senses of the word. Familiarity of candidate cue word was computed as the frequency of unigram and bigram constituents over the English subset of the spoken language corpus OpenSubtitles Tiedemann and Luo (2026) and Wikipedia dump 2026 3 3 3 https://dumps.wikimedia.org/enwiki/ . If unavailable in either corpus, we used the wordfreq Python package 4 4 4 https://pypi.org/project/wordfreq/ to assign a familiarity score. We fine-tuned a BERT model Devlin et al. (2019) on the MRC Psycholinguistic Database Coltheart (1981) to predict imageability of the cue words (Appendix A ). We used the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings Wang et al. (2020) to compute the cosine similarity between the cue word’s alternate meaning and the candidate answer ( e.g., “screwdriver - tool” and “screwdriver - cocktail”). We manually annotated 152 candidate cue words and then trained a logistic regression model to learn the boundaries for all filters jointly. Post-filtering, we iteratively regenerated candidate cue words until each candidate puzzle had at least 3 acceptable candidates or reached 3 repair steps.
blocks.zh: 该模型产生了3,340个口号候选人。 为了确保提示词能在视觉的RAT谜题中被作为适当的提示图像来表示,我们应用了过滤步骤来说明词的高度熟悉性,高可视性,以及词的两个感相之间的高距离. 候选人提示词的通俗性被计算为单语和bigram成分的频率高于口语词汇OpenSubtitles Tiedemann和Luo(2026年)和维基百科推特2026 3 3 https://dumps.wikimedia.org/enwiki/。 如果两者中都找不到的话,我们用 " freq Python " 软件包4 4 4 https://pypi.org/project/wordfreq/来分配一个熟悉的分数。 我们在MRC心理语言数据库Coltheart(1981年)上微调了BERT模型Devlin等(2019年),以预测提示词的可视性(附录A. 我们用的是全MiniLM-L6-v2嵌入器 Wang等人(2020年)计算出提示词的替代含义与候选答案(例如 " 螺旋桨-工具 " 和 " 螺旋桨-鸡尾酒 " )的相近性。 我们手动说明152个候选的提示词,然后训练一个后勤回归模型,以便共同学习所有过滤器的界限。 过滤后,我们反复生成候选人提示词,直到每个候选人谜题至少有3个可接受的候选人或达到3个修补步骤。

blocks.en: After filtering, we obtained 729 text-only RAT puzzles that were manually extended with images from the free-to-use photo collection platforms Unsplash and Pexels 5 5 5 https://unsplash.com/ and https://pexels.com/ . We limited the puzzles in the final benchmark to three images, selecting the best-ranked candidate cue words when more than three were available using the logistic regression model. After manual image selection and verification, the final benchmark contains 155 puzzles spanning is-a , part-of , used-for , and symbol-of relations between the cue words and the connecting answer.
blocks.zh: 在过滤后,我们获得了729个仅文本的RAT谜题,这些谜题由免费取用相片收集平台的图像 Unsplash和Pexels 5 5 5 https://unsplash.com/和 https://pexels.com/手动扩展. 我们把最终基准中的谜题限制在三个图像上,在使用后勤回归模型提供三个以上时,选择排名最佳的候选人提示词。 经过人工图像选择和验证后,最终基准包含横跨-a,部分,用于-的155个谜题,以及提示词和连接答案之间的关系符号.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Human Study. We conducted a study with 25 participants to validate the quality and difficulty of our benchmark. The study was conducted on a subset of 80 puzzles, with each puzzle attempted by 5 participants. They were allowed up to three attempts to solve the puzzle, after which they were asked two questions about the association of the image and the cue word, and the cue word and the answer word. If they successfully solved the puzzle, an additional question was asked to rate the image’s helpfulness in solving the puzzle (see Appendix E for the user interface). The post-quiz survey concluded with open-ended questions about their puzzle-solving strategies and study experiences.
blocks.zh: 人类研究. 我们进行了一项有25人参加的研究,以验证我们基准的质量和难度。 这项研究涉及80个谜题的子集,每个谜题由5名参与者尝试. 他们被允许最多三次尝试解开谜题,之后他们被问及两个问题:图像和提示词的关联,提示词和答案词. 如果成功解决了谜题,则会询问一个额外的问题,以评价图像在解决谜题中的帮助(用户界面见附录E). 静音后调查最后提出了关于解决谜题的战略和研究经验的开放式问题。

blocks.en: VLM evaluation. To evaluate the creative reasoning of vision language models, we evaluated 7 open-weight models Molmo2-8B ( Clark et al., 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ) , Qwen3.8-27B , Qwen3.5-9B , Gemma-4-12B-it , InternVL3.5-8B ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , Llama-4-Scout-17B (w4a16) and 4 proprietary models GPT-5.6 Luna , GPT-5.6 Sol , Claude Haiku 4.5 , and Claude Opus 5.5 . We evaluated all models in five settings: zero-shot prompt directly asks to give the shared concept, detailed prompt provides details about the Remote Associates Task of finding an alternate meaning corresponding to the cue words, and stepwise prompt asks the model to first identify the words for each image to convert it into a RAT problem. We also investigate the text-only setting, where the VLMs are given directly the cue-words rather than cue-images. We use Gemini-3.5-Flash-Lite to assess answers in the human study and the generated VLM responses. Both generation and evaluation prompts are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: VLM评价. 为了评价视觉语言模型的创造性推理,我们评价了7个开放量模型Molmo2-8B(Clark等,2026年),DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash(DeepSeek-AI等,2026年),Qune3.8-27B,Quen3.5-9B,Gemma-4-12B-it,InternVL3.5-8B(Wang等,2025年),Llama-4-Scout-17B(W4a16)和4个专有量模型GPT-5.6 Luna,GPT-5.6 Sol,Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Opus 5.5. 我们评价了五种设置中的所有模型:零发即时直接请求给出共同的概念,详细即时提供远程关联任务的细节,寻找一个对应提示词的替代含义,并分步请模型首先为每个图像识别出词来将它转化为RAT问题. 我们还调查只使用文字的设置,即直接给VLM的提示字而不是提示图像. 我们使用双子座-3.5-Flash-Lite来评估人类研究中的答案和产生的VLM响应. 附录D提供了生成和评价提示。

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Table 1: Performance of humans and VLMs on the subset of 80 problems. VLMs were evaluated on five settings: zero-shot ( ZS ), detailed ( Det. ), stepwise ( SW ), two-shot ( 2-S ) and text-only ( Txt. ).
blocks.zh: 表1:人类和VLM在80个问题的子集上的性能. 对VLM进行了5个设置的评价:零发(ZS),详细(Det.),分步(SW.),双发(2-S.)和只发(Txt.).

blocks.en: To allow us to compare VLMs with human performance, we report the main results for the 80-puzzle subset in this section, with details on the full benchmark in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 为了让我们能够将VLMs与人类的性能进行比较,我们报告本节80个谜题子集的主要结果,并在附录B中详细列出全部基准。

blocks.en: The participants, on average, correctly solved 16.5% of the puzzles on the first attempt and 22.8% by the third attempt, spending 83.6 seconds per puzzle. However, performance varied across participants: 4 did not solve any problems, 5 solved one, 4 solved two, and five participants accounted for nearly half of the correct solutions (49%), with the best solving 12 of 16 puzzles. Participants solved 22.8% puzzles on average, with 70% puzzles being solved by at least one participant. Out of 80 puzzles, only 4 puzzles were solved by 3 out of 5 humans, while only one puzzle (cue words: bed , bank , mouth , connecting word river ) was answered by all five participants. The study indicates that the puzzles are challenging yet solvable. They further indicate that solving visual RAT problems is not a universal ability, as correct solutions were concentrated among a small group of strong solvers, while most participants solved few or none of them.
blocks.zh: 参与者平均在第一次尝试时正确解决了16.5%的谜题,第三次尝试时正确解决了22.8%的谜题,每个谜题花费了83.6秒. 然而,参与者的表现各有不同:4没有解决任何问题,5个解决了1个,4个解决了2个,5个参与者占了正确解决方案的近一半(49%),16个谜题中最好的解决了12个. 参与者平均解决了22.8%的谜题,至少一个参与者解决了70%的谜题. 在80个谜题中,只有4个谜题由5个人类中的3个解出,而只有1个谜题(cue words:band,bank, mouth ,连接单词"河")得到了全部5个参与者的回答. 研究表明,这些谜题具有挑战性,但却是可以解开的。 他们进一步表示,解决视觉RAT问题并不是一种普遍的能力,因为正确的解决方案集中在少数强解者身上,而大多数参与者解决了其中的少数或全部.

blocks.en: We provide the human and VLM performance on our CREATE benchmark in Table 1 . In the zero-shot setting, only one VLM outperformed the average human performance, with Claude-Opus-5.5 solving 32.5% of the puzzles. All other VLMs struggled to solve the puzzles, the next best model achieving 12.5% accuracy. Of the 56 puzzles solved by at least one human participant, 22 were solved by Claude-Opus-5.5 . There were four instances where Claude-Opus-5.5 solved the puzzle when none of the participants could solve them.
blocks.zh: 我们在表1中提供了人类和VLM的性能。 在"零射出"设定中,只有一款VLM的表现超过了人类的平均性能,克洛德-奥普斯-5.5解了32.5%的谜题. 所有其他VLM为解谜而挣扎,下个最佳模型达到了12.5%的精度. 在至少有一位人类参与者解开的56个谜题中,有22个由克洛德-奥普斯-5.5解开. Claude-Opus-5.5在4个实例中解开了谜题,当时没有一个参与者能够解开.

blocks.en: Prompting strategies had uneven effects relative to the zero-shot setting, with stepwise prompting having a significant impact on Claude-Opus-5.5 (+11.3 points), and detailed prompt improving the performance of six models ( Claude-Opus-5.5 : +20.0, GPT-5.6-Sol : +16.3, DeepSeek-Flash : +8.8). The two-shot setting improved the stronger reasoning model’s performance, while reducing the three open-weight models to zero. In contrast, the text-only setting improved every model by 30.0 to 66.3 points, with Claude-Opus-5.5 reaching 90.0%, suggesting that the main bottleneck lies in recovering the correct concepts from images rather than in finding the association itself.
blocks.zh: 相较于"零射出"的设定,快取策略效果不均匀,分步相向地提示对克洛德-奥普斯-5.5(+11.3分)有重大影响,并详细迅速改进了6个模型的性能(克洛德-奥普斯-5.5分:+20.0分,GPT-5.6-Sol:+16.3分,DeepSeek-Flash:+8. 二发设定提高了更强推理模型的性能,同时将三个开口量模型降到了零. 相形之下,只用文本设置将每个模型都改进了30.0到66.3分,克洛德-奥普斯-5.5达到90.0%,说明主要的瓶颈在于从图像中恢复正确的概念,而不是找到关联本身.

blocks.en:
Participants’ performance remained steady throughout the study, with similar success rates for the first and last eight problems (22.5% and 23.0%).
Participants’ self-reported experiences also reflected this, with only 4 reporting that the puzzles became easier over time. This aligns with Metcalfe and Wiebe (1987) , who showed that insight problems (such as RAT) are solved by sudden realization, in contrast to non-insight problems ( e.g., algebra), which can be learned incrementally.
blocks.zh:
在整个研究过程中,参与者的业绩保持稳定,第一和第二八个问题的成功率相似(22.5%和23.0%)。
与会者自报的经验也反映了这一点,只有4个报告表明,这些谜题随着时间推移变得更加容易。 这与Metcalfe和Wiebe(1987年)一致,后者表明洞察力问题(如RAT)通过突然实现来解决,与非洞察力问题(如代数)形成对比,后者可以被渐进地学习.

blocks.en: Providing the cue words directly in the text-only setting significantly improved the models’ performance, with the best-performing VLM solving 90% of the puzzles. This means that while the models possess the conceptual knowledge needed to link words to their shared category, they are unable to retrieve those words from images. The stepwise condition shows that even reaching the words is not sufficient. Considering 146 runs in which a model’s own response named all three intended words correctly, the model identified the shared concept only 26% of the time. Given the same words as text, the models solved the puzzles 53% of the time. This disagreement was mostly unidirectional, with only three puzzles where the stepwise outperformed the text-only . Therefore, correctly identifying the concept in each image does not guarantee that a VLM will solve the puzzle, and the presence of the images actively interferes with linking words the model has already produced.
blocks.zh: 直接在仅文本设置中提供提示词,大大改善了模型的性能,其中最出色的VLM解决了90%的谜题。 这意味着,虽然模型拥有将词与所共享的类别联系起来所需的概念知识,但它们无法从图像中取出这些词. 相继条件表明,即使达到单词也是不够的. 考虑到146个模式本身的反应正确命名了所有三个意图字,该模式只确定了26%的时间。 鉴于与文本的同名词,模型解决了53%的时间的谜题. 这种分歧大多是单向的,只有三个谜题,其阶梯效果优于文本。 因此,正确识别每个图像中的概念并不能保证一个VLM能解开谜题,而图像的存在会积极干扰模型已经产生的连接词.

blocks.en: The model’s wrong responses help understand the nature of this interference. Rather than abstracting from the images to the intended alternative sense, models frequently answer with the images’ literal content. 22.8% of the models’ wrong answers describe what the photographs literally depict, compared with 8.9% of human participants’ wrong guesses. These literal interpretations varied from the models fixating on one image ( e.g., predicting “Denmark" for < Danish flag, French horn , bear claw ; pastry >) or a superficial property within the images ( e.g., predicting “spiral" for < spiral seashell , bent elbow , wagon wheel ; pasta >). This disparity illustrates that models are more likely to commit to the first surface-level connection they find than to search for a deeper association. Humans often recognized when they had no satisfactory answer; participants gave up on 37.5% of puzzles, with 19.8% without event taking a guess. In contrast, models produced an answer for every puzzle even when the best connection available to them rested on a single image or a shared visual feature.
blocks.zh: 该模型的错误反应有助于理解这种干涉的性质. 模型往往用图像的文字内容来回答,而不是从图像抽象到预期的另类意义。 22.8%的模型错误的答案描述了照片的字面描述,而8.9%的人类参与者错误的猜测。 这些文字解释各不相同,从固定在一个图像上的模型(例如,预测丹麦国旗、法国角、熊爪;糕点)或图像中的表面属性(例如,预测 " 螺旋贝壳 " 、 " 弯肘 " 、 " 马车轮 " ; " 面 " )。 这种差异表明,模型更有可能致力于它们发现的第一个地表级连接,而不是寻求更深层次的联系。 人类在没有满意的答案时往往会被认出来;参与者放弃了37.5%的谜题,19.8%没有事件猜测. 相比之下,模型为每一个谜题都提供了答案,即使它们可以得到的最佳连接依赖于一个单一的图像或一个共同的视觉特征.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced CREATE , a benchmark of 155 visual RAT problems for measuring creative reasoning in vision-language models. We conducted a human study to confirm the benchmark validity. Our experiments with 11 VLMs found that only one model exceeded average human performance in the zero-shot setting (32.5% vs. 22.8%), and no other model solved more than 12.5% of the puzzles. Our analysis found that the model failures differ from human failures, with nearly a quarter of incorrect model answers being literal image descriptions, compared to ∼ {\sim} 9% of such human errors. The models were able to solve the text-only simplifications of the puzzles but were unable to solve the same visual puzzles, even after correctly identifying the intermediate cue words, suggesting a limitation of VLMs in visual abstraction rather than in the association formulation.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了CREATE, 以155个视觉RAT问题为基准, 我们进行了一次人类研究,以确认基准的有效性。 我们用11个VLM的实验发现,在零镜头设定中,只有一个模型超过了人类平均性能(32.5%对22.8%),没有其他模型解决了超过12.5%的谜题. 我们的分析发现,模型失败与人类失败不同,近四分之一的不正确的模型答案是字面的图像描述,而这种人类错误的百分之九. 这些模型能够解决谜题的仅文本简化,但无法解决同一种视觉谜题,甚至在正确识别出中间提示词后,就暗示了VLM在视觉抽象而非关联配方上的局限性.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This work has two limitations. First , we restricted our images to free stock-photo collections for the benchmark curation. This limited the constructed puzzles to those that had appropriate images in the photo collections, limiting the size of our final dataset. We refrained from using synthetic images in our dataset because of computational costs and quality concerns of model-generated images. We leave the extension of our benchmark to future work. Second , while our benchmark design emphasized on generic concepts and explicitly included word familiarity filters, some target concepts required expert domain knowledge or specialized vocabulary ( e.g., driver, shell, pipe is connected to “operating system”). An incorrect answer may therefore reflect unfamiliarity with a word’s domain sense, and we did not distinguish between a lack of knowledge and difficulty in using that knowledge to find the shared concept.
blocks.zh: 这项工作有两个局限性。 首先,我们把图像限制在免费的股票图片收藏上,用于基准校正. 这使得所构建的谜题仅限于那些在相片集中拥有适当图像的谜题,限制了我们最终数据集的大小. 由于模型生成的图像的计算成本和质量问题,我们没有在数据集中使用合成图像。 我们把我们的基准扩大到今后的工作。 其次,虽然我们的基准设计强调通用概念,并明确包括字面熟悉过滤器,但有些目标概念需要专家领域知识或专门词汇(例如驱动程序、外壳、管子与“操作系统”相连)。 因此,一个错误的答案可能反映了对一个词域感的不熟悉,我们没有区分知识的缺乏和使用知识寻找共同概念的困难。

blocks.en: Appendix A Training an Imageability Filtration Model
blocks.zh: 附录A 培训可显示性过滤模型

blocks.en: Our work draws on prior work on imageability for our dataset curation. In psycholinguistics, imageability is a measure of how easily a word evokes a mental image or sensory experience. Literature in imageability spans almost half a century, with the earliest work in imageability collecting imageability scores for 925 nouns Paivio et al. (1968) ; Paivio (2013) . The MRC Psycholinguistic Database Coltheart (1981) consolidated imageability annotations from prior work ( Gilhooly and Logie, 1980 ; Cortese and Fugett, 2004 ) , and remains one of the largest resources for word imageability with over 100k word ratings. As human ratings are costly, one line of work developed automatic imageability estimation systems. Ljubešić et al. (2018) showed that word embeddings predict the correctness and imageability of words well within and across languages. Vision-based approaches primarily use image characteristics obtained via search (from datasets or the internet) to determine the imageability of the word used as the search query Kiela et al. (2014) ; Hessel et al. (2018) ; Kastner et al. (2019) . Recently, generative models have been used to generate images rather than for retrieval ( Wu and Smith, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的工作借鉴了我们数据集的可视性工作。 在心理语言学中,可想象性是衡量一个词如何容易地引出一个心理形象或感官体验的尺度. 成像性的文学跨越了近半个世纪,最早的成像性工作是收集出925名名名词"Paivio等"(1968年;Paivio(2013). MRC心理语言学数据库 Coltheart(1981年)综合了前作(吉尔霍利和洛吉, 1980; Cortese and Fugett, 2004 ),并仍然是单词可视性最大的资源之一,收视率超过100克. 由于人类的评级成本高昂,一行工作发展出自动可成像性估计系统. Ljubešić等人(2018年)表明,嵌入词预言了在语言内部和语言之间的词的正确性和可形象性。 基于愿景的方法主要利用通过搜索(从数据集或互联网)获得的图像特征来确定用作搜索查询的单词的可图像性(Kiela等(2014);Hessel等 (2018);Kastner等 (2019)。 最近,基因模型被用于生成图像而不是取回(Wu and Smith, 2023.).

blocks.en: Following this recent trend, we trained our own word imageability model to obtain a generalizable mechanism to estimate word imageability for unknown words and used it as a filtration step in our benchmark curation process. We fine-tuned a BERT-base-uncased model ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) on imageability ratings from the MRC Psycholinguistic Database Coltheart (1981) . We kept nouns with valid imageability ratings and at least two letters, converted them to lowercase, and removed duplicates, resulting in 4,196 words in total. Using stratified sampling, we selected 100 words in total across each of five imageability ranges, and trained the model on the remaining 4,096 words. We converted the original ratings from a 100-700 scale to a 1-5 scale, rounded them to the nearest integer, and trained the model as a classifier with 5 classes. The model achieved 72.0% accuracy with a mean absolute error of 0.28, which outperformed GPT-5.1 , GPT-5.2 , and GPT-5-mini , which we tested with different prompts on the same evaluation set.
blocks.zh: 根据最近的趋势,我们培训了自己的文字可象性模型,以获得一种通用机制,用以估计未知文字的文字可象性,并在我们的基准校正过程中将其作为过滤步骤. 我们微调了一个BERT-base-uncased模型(Devlin等, 2019年), 我们保留了名词具有有效可成像的收视率,并且至少有两个字母,将其转换为小写,并去除重复,总共产生了4,196个字. 使用分层取样,我们总共选择了100个字,跨越了五个可图像范围,并对模型进行了其余4,096个字的培训。 我们把原收视率由100-700分级改为1-5分级,将收视率四舍五入到最接近的整数,并训练出该模型作为分级员,分为5个班. 该模型实现了72.0%的精度,平均绝对误差为0.28,其性能超过了GPT-5.1,GPT-5.2,以及GPT-5-mini,我们在同一套评价中用不同的提示测试了这些精度.

blocks.en:
This section reports results for the 80 human study puzzles as well as all 155 final puzzles. Table 3 presents the results of using single image captioning to solve the task, and our benchmark has only one image (corresponding to the puzzle < buck, nickel, bills ; money >) where the generated caption for the image representing nickel gives away the answer money.

本节报告80个人类研究谜题以及全部155个最终谜题的结果. 表3列出使用单一图像标题来完成这项任务的结果,我们的基准只有一个图像(对应拼图 < buck、nick、bills;money > ),代表镍的图像生成的字幕给人解答金钱。

blocks.en: Table 4 reports results for the 80 human study puzzles as well as all 155 final puzzles. We calculated both exact matching score and token precision, recall, and F1 to measure how much the answer overlaps with the intended word. We report the additional P/R/F1 because exact matching would count more specific labels, such as "bamboo steamer," for "steamer" as incorrect. This mattered especially for Claude-Opus-5.5 , since it was found to often include extra words. However, it achieved the highest recall, at 53.1% for the first prediction and 74.0% for the best of five predictions on the 80 human puzzles. These longer labels contribute to the gap between its recall and exact-match accuracy. Although other models also achieved relatively high recall compared to accuracy, the difference was not particularly noticeable.
blocks.zh: 表4报告80个人类研究谜题以及所有155个最终谜题的结果。 我们计算准确的比分和符号的精确度,回忆,以及F1,以衡量答案与预定词的相重叠程度. 我们报告增加的P/R/F1,因为精确的匹配会算入更具体的标签,例如"bamboo蒸汽机",表示"蒸汽机"是不正确的. 这对克洛德-奥普斯-5.5尤其重要,因为人们发现它经常包括额外的词. 然而,它实现了最高的回想,第一次预测为53.1%,80个人类谜题的5个预测中最好的是74.0%. 这些较长的标签造成了其召回和准确匹配的准确性之间的差距. 虽然与准确性相比,其他模型的召回率也相对较高,但差别并不特别明显。

blocks.en: Table 5: Performance of models under the five prompting settings on all 155 puzzles.
blocks.zh: 表5 所有155个谜题在五个提示设置下的模型性能.

blocks.en: Table 5 presents model performance on identifying the shared concept under the five prompt settings on all 155 puzzles. The result trends are similar to the subset of 80 puzzles reported in the main paper (Section 5 ). The text-only prompt led to better performance, and Claude-Opus-5.5 performed best across all five prompt settings. However, the accuracy was generally lower on all 155 puzzles, especially for the text-only prompt setting. All eleven models performed better under the Text-only prompt setting on the 80 human study puzzles. For GPT-5.6-Luna , it got 61.3% correct on the 80 human study puzzles and dropped to 33.3% on the remaining 75 puzzles, suggesting that models find it hard to identify the shared concepts in the remaining 75 puzzles. While the drop in performance from the subset of 80 problems to the entire dataset was consistent, its magnitude varied across the studied VLMs.
blocks.zh: 表5列出了在所有155个谜题的五个即时设置下确定共同概念的模型性能。 结果趋势类似于主要文件(第5节)所报道的80个谜题的子集。 只有文本的快取导致性能更好,克洛德-奥普斯-5.5在所有五个快取设置中表现最好. 然而,在所有155个谜题中,准确度普遍较低,特别是只用文本的即时设置。 所有11个模型在80个人类研究谜题的仅文本的即时设置下表现较好。 对于GPT-5.6-Luna,它在80个人类研究谜题上得到了61.3%的正确度,在剩下的75个谜题上下降到了33.3%,这表明模型发现在剩下的75个谜题中很难识别共同的概念. 虽然从80个问题子集到整个数据集的性能下降是始终如一的,但其规模因研究的VLM而异.

blocks.en: Table 6: Model accuracy in recognizing intended cue words when given one or two labeled images from the same puzzle, using normalized exact matching, on the 80 human-study puzzles and all 155 puzzles. For each VLM, we present the average of all six possible combinations of one cue and all three possible combinations.
blocks.zh: 表6:在80个人文研究谜题和全部155个谜题上,在从同一个谜题中给出一个或两个被标注的图像时,识别意向提示词的模型精度,使用规范精确的匹配. 对于每个VLM,我们给出了所有六个可能的组合的平均值,一个提示和所有三个可能的组合.

blocks.en: We also studied the model’s capability to associate words with images and to predict the cue word corresponding to an image, given one or two image-cue word pairs from the same puzzle. Table 6 presents the aggregate results over all six possible combinations of one cue word, and all three possible combinations with two cue words. Compared to zero-shot cue word generation from a single image (Table 4 ), models performed much better when given one or two labeled images. Across the 80 human study puzzles, one cue improved nine of the eleven models, and two cues improved ten, compared with top-1 accuracy without cues, indicating that context from other images helps models better identify the intended words. When given two labeled images, Claude-Opus-5 ’s performance increased from 21.3% to 88.3%, and GPT-5.6-Sol increased from 26.3% to 75.4%. Qwen3.5-9B was the only model with a performance drop from 36.3% to 30.8%. Two cue accuracy ranks the models similarly to text-only accuracy, with a rank correlation of about 0.9, suggesting that intended words and shared concepts need to be worked out together. One reason for the increased accuracy of some models that generate verbose captions (such as Claude-Opus-5.5 ) could be that they have learned to respond succinctly in this one- or two-shot setting.
blocks.zh: 我们还研究了模型将文字与图像联系起来的能力,并预测一个图像对应的提示词,从同一个谜题中给出一到两个图像提示词对. 表6列出所有六个可能组合的1个提示词和所有三个可能组合的2个提示词的汇总结果。 相较于从单个图像(表4)中取出零发提示字生成,模型在给定一两个被标记的图像时表现要好得多. 在80个人类研究谜题中,一个提示改进了11个模型中的9个,两个提示改进了10个,而顶一的精度没有提示,这表明其他图像的背景有助于模型更好地识别预期的词. Claude-Opus-5的性能从21.3%上升到88.3%, Quen3.5-9B是唯一一个性能从36.3%下降到30.8%的模型. 两个提示精度将模型排序为类似只用文本的精度,排名关联度约为0.9等,说明要用词和共同的概念需要一起研究. 产生动词标题的一些模型(如克洛德-奥普斯-5.5)的精度提高的一个原因可能是,它们学会了在这个一发或两发的设定中作出简洁的反应.

blocks.en: The best-performing model was Claude-Opus-5.5 across both conditions and puzzle sets. Under the one cue setting, each image has two possible cues, and models sometimes answered correctly with one cue but incorrectly with the other. Across all eleven models, this occurred in 29-70 of the 240 images in the 80 puzzle subset, suggesting that providing different cues can lead to different interpretations of the same image. For example, Claude-Opus-5.5 predicted "wedge" correctly when given "mule", but gave "brie" when given "pump". We also found that adding one more cue does not always help models to predict better. For every model, there were cases when they recognized the image correctly with either cue but incorrectly with both cues. This happened for 1-17 of the 240 images per model. For example, Claude-Opus-5.5 answered "teeth" with either "slider" or "tape," but "smile" when given both cues.
blocks.zh: 表现最佳的模型是Claude-Opus-5.5,既涉及条件,也涉及谜题集. 在一个提示设置下,每个图像都有两个可能的提示,模型有时用一个提示正确回答,但用另一个提示错误回答. 在所有11个模型中,这发生在80个谜题子集中的240个图像中的29-70个,这表明提供不同的提示可以导致对同一图像的不同解释. 例如克洛德-奥普斯-5.5在给出"mule"时对"wedge"进行了正确的预测,但在给出"pump"时给出了"brie". 我们还发现,增加一个提示并不总是有助于模型更好地预测。 对于每一个模型,都有这样的情况:他们用两个提示正确识别图像,但用两个提示都错误地识别图像。 这发生在每个模型240个图像中的1至17个. 例如克洛德-奥普斯-5.5用"滑行"或"磁带"来回答"牙齿",但给与两个提示时" smile".

blocks.en: This section compares human and model performance in detail. Figure 2 presents how many puzzles were solved by humans only, models only, both, or neither under the five prompt settings. In total, 56 puzzles were solved by at least one human, but only 39 were solved by at least one model. The figure also shows that models and humans do not always solve the same puzzles. Under the Zero-shot setting, 30 puzzles were solved by both humans and at least one model, 26 by human only, 9 by models only, and 15 by neither. However, it is also interesting to see that though they do not always solve the same sets of problems, under the zero-shot setting, Claude-Opus-5.5 solved 39.3% of puzzles that participants solved within three attempts, and only solved 16.7% of puzzles that no participant solved, suggesting that puzzles solved by humans are also more likely to be solved by the model.
blocks.zh: 本节详细比较了人类和模型性能. 图2显示仅由人类解出多少个谜题,模型仅由人类解出,两者兼而有之,或者在五个即时设置下都没有解出. 总共56个谜题被至少一个人类解开,但只有39个谜题被至少一个模型解开. 该图还显示模型和人类并不总是能解决相同的谜题. 在"零射出"设定下,有30个谜题被人类双方和至少一个模型解开,26个仅由人类解开,9个仅由模型解开,15个均由两者解开. 然而,同样有趣的是,虽然他们并不总是能解决同一组问题,但在零镜头设定下,克洛德-奥普斯-5.5解开了参与者在三次尝试中解开的39.3%的谜题,而只有16.7%的谜题没有参与者解开,这表明由人类解开的谜题也更有可能被模型解开.

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows that model success often differs across models. Out of the 39 puzzles that were solved by at least one model, 22 were solved by only one. Participants solved 26 puzzles that all eleven models missed, while models solved nine puzzles that no participant solved within three attempts. For example, all five participants solved the "river" puzzle, but only Claude-Opus-5.5 solved it. Conversely, Molmo2-8B , Qwen3.8-27B , and Claude-Haiku-4.5 solved the stage puzzle, while no participant solved it. The examples show that puzzles solved by several participants were not necessarily solved by several models, and vice versa.
blocks.zh: 图6显示,模型成功往往因模型而异. 在至少一个模型解开的39个谜题中,有22个只有1个解开. 参与者解决了所有11个模型都错过的26个谜题,而模型解决了9个谜题,没有参与者在3个尝试中解决. 例如,这五个参与者都解决了"河流"谜题,但只有克洛德-奥普斯-5.5解决了. 相反地,Molmo2-8B ,Quen3.8-27B,克洛德-海库-4.5解开舞台谜题,而没有参与者解开. 这些例子表明,几个参与者解开的谜题不一定由几个模型解开,反之亦然.

blocks.en: Puzzles that participants rated as harder also tended to be solved by fewer models. For the 80 human puzzles, higher mean difficulty ratings are associated with fewer participants solving the puzzle within three attempts (Spearman’s ρ = − 0.757 \rho=-0.757 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) and fewer models solving it in the Zero-shot setting ( ρ = − 0.331 \rho=-0.331 , p = 0.006 p=0.006 ). The p p -values are Holm-adjusted.
blocks.zh: 参与者评为更难的谜题也往往被较少的模型所解决. 对于80个人类谜题,更高的平均难度评分与三次尝试中解决谜题的参与者较少(Spearman's à = – 0.757\rho=-0.757,p < 0.001 p < 0.001)相关,而零发设定中解题的模型较少(ρ = 0.331\rho=-0.331,p=0.006 p=0.006). p-值为霍尔姆调整.

blocks.en: Table 8 shows how often models included the intended word in the five possible words when humans reported thinking about it. Models often included the intended word when participants reported having thought about it. We further found that when all five participants reported having thought about the word, the models achieved higher accuracy, ranging from 50.0% to 81.5% on these 92 images compared with 30.6% to 47.9% on the other 144 images, suggesting some similarity in identifying intended words.
blocks.zh: 表8显示当人类报告思考时,模型在可能使用的5个单词中是否经常包括预定的单词. 模型中常常包括参与者报告考虑过时的用词. 我们进一步发现,当所有五个参与者都报告考虑过这个词时,模型的准确度更高,这92幅图像的准确度从50.0%到81.5%不等,而其他144幅图像的准确度从30.6%到47.9%不等,这表明在识别意向词方面有些相似.

blocks.en: We used pretrained checkpoints without fine-tuning. Our local launcher defaults were bfloat16 computation, a 32,768-token context limit, a maximum of 8,192 batched tokens, one concurrent sequence, and 0.90 GPU memory utilization. Some launch commands used the context limit of 16,384 and the memory utilization limit of 0.95.
blocks.zh: 我们使用未经调整的预先训练的检查站。 我们的本地发射装置默认为:bfloat16计算、32 768个上下文限制、最多8 192个批发的信号、一个同步序列和0.90 GPU内存利用率。 一些发射指令使用了上下文限制为16,384和内存使用限制为0.95.

blocks.en: We used a 512-token output limit for Qwen and a 1,024-token limit for Gemma, InternVL, and Llama Scout. Molmo’s output limit was left to the server default. Thinking was disabled for Qwen and Gemma. The evaluator did not override temperature, top- p p , or top- k k , and the unseeded repeated runs did not supply a request seed.
blocks.zh: 我们用512个托肯输出限制给Quen,用1024个托肯限制给Gemma,InternVL,和Llama Scout. Mollmo的输出限制留给服务器默认值. 为Quen和Gemma而思维被禁用. 评估者没有超过温度,顶-p-p,或顶-k-k-k,没有种子的重复运行没有提供请求种子.
